sloka: त्रिविष्टपम् ब्रह्म लोकम् लोकानाम् परम ईश्वरः ।विश्वामित्रो अपि तत् श्रुत्वा ह्रिया किंचित् अवाङ्मुखः ॥१-५७-७॥
transliteration: triviṣṭapam brahma lokam lokānām parama īśvaraḥ ।viśvāmitro api tat śrutvā hriyā kiṁcit avāṅmukhaḥ ॥1-57-7॥

translations.english: "O Men endowed with the wealth of asceticism I was rejected by my guru and now by his sons. I shall seek another way. Farewell to you".
